result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: truncated restaurant names in the Fastest near you carousel and a partially cut-off delivery fee label on one card.

issues.description: The third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' is truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size on overflow, or ensure card width accommodates typical restaurant name lengths without clipping.

issues.description: The delivery fee text under the third Fastest card ('€1.90 delivery') appears cut off at the right edge of the card.
issues.suggestion: Ensure secondary text fits within the card bounds, wraps, or uses ellipsis consistently with adequate padding.
